modules.doc: Mycelium — neural-style persistent memory for Claude Code.
Read-only web graph explorer for a Mycelium memory database.
Optional embedding client for semantic recall.
Reproducible recall benchmark: lexical vs hybrid (semantic) recall.
Drain JSONL decision logs into SQLite foundry_decisions.
Fail-soft JSONL writer. Never blocks the caller, never raises.
Foundry SQLite schema. Idempotent — safe to call on every connection.

symbols.name: _cmd_init
symbols.doc: Copy the bundled config.example.toml to a user-writable path.

symbols.name: _config_search_paths
symbols.doc: Where to look for config.toml, in order of precedence.

symbols.name: _deep_merge
symbols.doc: Recursively merge overlay into base (overlay wins on leaves).

symbols.name: _coerce
symbols.doc: Coerce a string env var to the type of the existing default.

symbols.name: _apply_env_overrides
symbols.doc: MYCELIUM_SERVER_PORT=9000 -> cfg['server']['port'] = 9000.

symbols.name: _expand_paths
symbols.doc: Expand ~ and $VAR in known path keys.

symbols.name: load
symbols.doc: Load config from disk + env, layered over defaults.

symbols.name: _DB
symbols.doc: Opens the memory database read-only. Raises if it does not exist.

symbols.name: serve
symbols.doc: Start the read-only dashboard HTTP server (blocking).

symbols.name: embed_document
symbols.doc: One L2-normalized vector for a memory. Long content is chunked and the

symbols.name: embed_query
symbols.doc: One L2-normalized query vector.

symbols.name: to_blob
symbols.doc: Serialize a vector to a compact little-endian float32 BLOB.

symbols.name: cosine_sims
symbols.doc: {memory_id: cosine} for rows of (memory_id, blob).

symbols.name: healthy
symbols.doc: True if the embedding endpoint answers — used for graceful fallback.

symbols.name: _ranked_ids
symbols.doc: Pull memory ids, in order, from recall()'s formatted output.

symbols.name: run_eval
symbols.doc: Returns {dataset, n_memories, n_queries, semantic_enabled, lexical, hybrid}.

symbols.name: _to_row
symbols.doc: Convert a JSON record to the parameter tuple for INSERT_SQL.

symbols.name: drain_file
symbols.doc: Drain one JSONL file. Returns count of rows ingested this call.

symbols.name: drain_all
symbols.doc: Drain every *.jsonl in log_dir into the foundry DB. Returns total rows.

symbols.name: query
symbols.doc: Read decisions back. Filter on any combination of fields.

symbols.name: set_log_dir
symbols.doc: Pin the log directory at runtime (called by server.set_config).

symbols.name: _resolve_log_dir
symbols.doc: Where to write today's JSONL. Order: explicit override > env var > default.

symbols.name: publish
symbols.doc: Append one decision row to today's JSONL.

symbols.name: init_schema
symbols.doc: Apply schema. Idempotent.

symbols.name: _is_protected
symbols.doc: memory tuple shape: (id, content, project, tier, last_accessed, confidence, pinned).

symbols.name: run_maintenance
symbols.doc: Run the four-phase consolidation. Default is dry-run (no writes).

symbols.name: format_report
symbols.doc: Render a run_maintenance() result as a readable report.

symbols.name: set_config
symbols.doc: Override the runtime config — useful for tests and the CLI.

symbols.name: resilient
symbols.doc: Wrap an MCP tool with a connection-cleanup net + transient-error retry.

symbols.name: _log_embed_failure
symbols.doc: Log an embed failure at WRITE TIME so it is visible immediately, not only

symbols.name: _log_stale_vectors
symbols.doc: Warn (once per stale combo) when memory_vectors holds vectors from a model

symbols.name: _semantic_sims
symbols.doc: {memory_id: cosine} over stored vectors PRODUCED BY THE ACTIVE MODEL.

symbols.name: _embed_memory
symbols.doc: Best-effort: embed one memory and upsert its vector. Never raises.

symbols.name: backfill_vectors
symbols.doc: Embed all memories into memory_vectors. Idempotent + resumable: skips

symbols.name: _apply_decay
symbols.doc: Apply decay to all connections, prune dead ones. Pinned memories get a floor.

symbols.name: save
symbols.doc: Save a memory. Keep it short and dense — one idea per memory.

symbols.name: resolve
symbols.doc: Create a disambiguation memory for an ambiguous term.

symbols.name: recall
symbols.doc: Search memories and propagate through connections.

symbols.name: context
symbols.doc: Load startup context — the hubs of your memory network.

symbols.name: _column_exists
symbols.doc: True if `col` exists on `table`. Lets recent() run on schemas both before

symbols.name: _humanize_age
symbols.doc: Compact age like '9m' / '3h' / '5d' from an ISO timestamp.

symbols.name: _recent_rows
symbols.doc: Recency-ranked memories (episodic view), newest first. READ-ONLY: no

symbols.name: _recent_summary_line
symbols.doc: One dense line for the digest: id, age, markers, trimmed content.

symbols.name: recent
symbols.doc: Recent episodic digest — what's been worked on lately, newest first.

symbols.name: wake_route
symbols.doc: Read-only recency digest for a SessionStart shell hook to curl.

symbols.name: review
symbols.doc: Review the health of the memory network.

symbols.name: _protection_reason
symbols.doc: Why a memory must NOT be auto-forgotten, or None if it is fair game.

symbols.name: consolidate
symbols.doc: Show memories ready for consolidation.

symbols.name: discover
symbols.doc: Discover hidden connections in the memory network.

symbols.name: forget
symbols.doc: Delete a memory and all its connections.

symbols.name: pin
symbols.doc: Pin or unpin a memory. Pinned memories' connections never decay below the

symbols.name: maintain
symbols.doc: Periodic memory consolidation — snapshot, plan, cold-mark, orphan rescue.

symbols.name: connections
symbols.doc: Show all connections for a specific memory — the local network topology.

symbols.name: serve
symbols.doc: Start the MCP server. Args override config.
